description: The type of a class. `type` is the default; a subclass of `type` customizes how classes are prepared, created, initialized and called.
Metaclass classmethod that returns the mapping the class body runs in, called before the body executes (PEP 3115).
Build and then initialize the class object from its name, bases and namespace when the class statement runs.
Runs when the class is called; `type.__call__` creates the instance with `__new__` and then runs `__init__`.
`TypeError` raised when no candidate metaclass is a subclass of the metaclasses of all bases; fixed by a metaclass that inherits from both.
